title: Navan Edge vs. Google AI Mode: Which is better for business travel?
summary: Compare Navan Edge and Google AI Mode for work-trip planning, booking, loyalty, and available support. See which fits your next business trip.
body_markdown:
Booking a work trip means fitting travel around a commitment: arriving before a meeting, staying close enough to avoid a long commute, and finding a flight you would actually want to take again next month. The cheapest option may be less useful than one that saves a connection or earns rewards with your preferred program.


Google AI Mode brings conversational research to Google Search, including flight and hotel comparisons, fare tracking, and points-or-miles rates.\[¹\] Navan Edge is a personal AI travel agent for people who book their own work trips, with flights, hotels, and restaurant reservations available in chat.\[⁵\]


The biggest differences show up when you're ready to book, want recommendations that match your preferences, or need help during a trip. We'll compare how each tool handles booking, personalization, loyalty, and travel support so you can decide which fits the way you travel.


### Key takeaways


- Google AI Mode is useful for comparing flights, hotels, fares, and points or miles before deciding where to book.\[1\]
- Navan Edge is designed for travelers who book their own work trips and want to arrange flights, hotels, and restaurant reservations through one travel conversation.
- Google AI Mode directs flight purchases to airlines or booking platforms and supports hotel checkout for select properties, while Navan Edge lets travelers review and confirm flights, hotels, and restaurant reservations in chat.\[1\]\[3\]\[5\]
- Google AI Mode hotel reservations are serviced by the hotel or booking partner, while Navan Edge provides 24/7 travel support in the same conversation used to plan and book, with human experts available when needed.\[3\]\[5\]


## What’s the verdict on Navan Edge vs. Google AI Mode?


Navan Edge is a better fit if you regularly book your own work trips and want a dedicated AI travel agent that remembers your preferences, handles bookings in chat, helps you get more from your loyalty programs, and provides 24/7 travel support.\[⁵\]


Google AI Mode is a strong choice when you're comparing flights, hotels, fares, and award prices before deciding where to book. It also supports hotel bookings for select properties through participating partners.\[¹\]\[³\]


The choice comes down to how you prefer to plan and book your trips: researching options across different booking routes or arranging the details through a dedicated travel assistant.


## How do Navan Edge and Google AI Mode compare?

## How do they both work in practice?


Imagine you have a client meeting in Chicago at 9 a.m. Wednesday. You want to arrive Tuesday evening, take a nonstop flight, stay within walking distance of the office, and book dinner for three, including a vegetarian client. You'd also prefer a hotel that participates in your loyalty program.


With Google AI Mode, you can compare flights and hotels, check points or miles rates, and track fares before booking.\[¹\] You'll purchase flights through an airline or booking platform. Google AI Mode also supports hotel bookings through Google Pay for select U.S. properties, subject to eligibility requirements.\[³\] For dinner, you can search availability across supported reservation platforms and follow a partner link to book.\[⁴\]


With Navan Edge, you can share those requirements in one conversation, review flight, hotel, and restaurant options, and confirm each booking in chat.\[⁵\] You can specify details such as a hotel within a ten-minute walk of the office or a vegetarian-friendly restaurant for your client dinner. Navan Edge uses that context alongside your connected loyalty programs to personalize recommendations.\[⁵\]


## Which works better for repeat business trips?


A single trip may be easy to describe from scratch. When the same route comes up every few weeks, the useful details are the ones that carry forward: your preferred airline, a quieter hotel, or the tradeoff you usually make between price and a connection.


Navan Edge uses preferences shared in chat, booking history, and connected loyalty programs to shape recommendations. It distinguishes a request for one trip from a longer-term preference: staying near a conference can apply to that visit, while preferring quieter hotels can shape future recommendations.\[⁵\]


Google AI Mode also supports personalization. Depending on your settings and eligibility, it can use previous searches, saved activity, and connected Google content apps, including Gmail and Google Calendar, to inform responses.\[²\] Navan Edge focuses that context on travel, using your stated preferences, booking history, and connected airline and hotel loyalty programs to recommend options for future trips.\[⁵\]


## How do the apps handle loyalty and rewards?


Loyalty can change which option is worth booking. A hotel a little farther from the office might fit your preferred program, while an award flight might use fewer miles but require a connection. The relevant question is whether the rewards justify the tradeoff on this particular trip.


Google AI Mode can show the points or miles required by supported airline and hotel partners, then send you to the partner’s site to redeem them.\[¹\] That makes it useful when you want to compare an award price with the cash fare before choosing a booking route.


Navan Edge's Loyalty Wallet brings supported airline and hotel programs together so you can manage your points, miles, and status in one place. It also uses connected programs to personalize recommendations and highlight potential earnings, making it easier to choose bookings that support your loyalty goals.\[⁵\]


With Navan Edge, you can earn rewards in multiple ways: loyalty points or miles on qualifying bookings, rewards or multipliers from an eligible credit card, and 5% back in Amazon Gift Cards on eligible hotel stays booked through the app.\[⁵\]


Google's award-search capabilities are separate from its hotel checkout. You can compare points or miles rates from supported partners, but hotel bookings completed through AI Mode currently don't support redeeming partner points or adding a loyalty number.\[¹\]\[³\] If you want to link the reservation to a loyalty account or request membership benefits, you can contact the hotel or booking partner after booking. Whether those benefits apply depends on the reservation and provider.\[³\]


## What support is available?


For a hotel booked through Google AI Mode, contact the hotel or booking platform for reservation help, changes, cancellations, or refunds. Google Support handles technical issues with AI Mode or Google Pay.\[³\]The fact that a reservation starts in Search does not make Google the company servicing it.


This is worth checking before payment: note the booking partner and keep its confirmation email. If you later need to ask about a room, payment, or cancellation, that tells you where to start. Flight purchases are made through the airline or booking platform.\[¹\]


Navan Edge provides 24/7 travel support in the same chat where you plan and book your trips. If your Chicago meeting moves and you need to change your flight or hotel, you can explain what happened and work through the options with the AI assistant. You approve any changes before they're made.\[⁵\]


If a request needs extra attention, you can ask a human travel expert to join the conversation. They'll have your trip details and chat history in context, so you don't have to start over or explain the situation again.


## Should you choose Navan Edge or Google AI Mode?


Choose Google AI Mode if you want to compare flights, hotels, fares, and award prices before deciding where to book. It's particularly useful when you're exploring options or tracking prices and are comfortable completing reservations through the available booking partners.\[¹\]\[³\] Choose Navan Edge if you regularly book your own work trips and want to arrange flights, hotels, and restaurants in one conversation while keeping your travel preferences and loyalty programs in view. You'll also have 24/7 travel support through the same chat, with human experts available if additional help is needed.\[⁵\]
